Nonparametric (case) bootstrap of a NONMEM model

Source: R/nm_bootstrap.R
nm_bootstrap.Rd

Nonparametric (case) bootstrap of a NONMEM model

Usage

nm_bootstrap(
  ctl,
  nmfe_path = NULL,
  n = 500L,
  ci = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  id_col = "ID",
  strata = NULL,
  comment_char = NULL,
  sep = ",",
  output_dir = NULL,
  keep_datasets = FALSE,
  keep_outputs = FALSE,
  strip_cov = TRUE,
  strip_tables = TRUE,
  add_warnings = TRUE,
  warnings_line = "$WARN WARN=NONE",
  include_rounding = FALSE,
  resume = TRUE,
  run = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cores = 1L,
  ...
)

Arguments

ctl

Path to the base control stream (.ctl).

nmfe_path

Path to the NONMEM launcher: nmfe*.bat on Windows (e.g. "C:/nm74g64/run/nmfe74.bat"), the nmfe script on Linux or macOS (e.g. "/opt/nm760/run/nmfe76").

n

Number of bootstrap replicates (default 500).

ci

Confidence level(s) for the percentile CI (default 0.95; e.g. c(0.95,0.90)).

seed

RNG seed for reproducibility (default: a random seed, stored in the result).

id_col

Label of the subject ID column, as it appears in $INPUT (default "ID").

strata

Optional $INPUT column to stratify the resampling on (constant within ID).

comment_char

Data-file comment/ignore character. NULL = auto-derive from the single-char IGNORE in $DATA ("@", "#", a letter...); "" = none.

sep

Data-file field separator (default ",").

output_dir

Working directory (default "<ctl_dir>/_bootstrap"). Formerly run_dir, still accepted with a warning.

keep_datasets

Keep each replicate data file? (default FALSE = space-optimal).

keep_outputs

Keep each replicate's NONMEM outputs? (default FALSE; .ext is read then removed).

strip_cov

Remove $COVARIANCE (default TRUE; useless for a bootstrap).

strip_tables

Remove $TABLE records (default TRUE; fixed FILE= names would collide). Formerly strip_table, which still works.

add_warnings

Insert a warning-suppression record (default TRUE).

warnings_line

Exact record inserted (default "$WARN WARN=NONE"; canonical form "$WARNINGS").

include_rounding

Count "minimisation successful, but rounding errors" runs as successful (default FALSE).

resume

Skip replicates already in bootstrap_estimates.csv (default TRUE).

run

FALSE = only build the optimised ctl + resample plan (dry run, no NONMEM).

verbose

Progress messages (default TRUE).

n_cores

Number of replicates run at the same time (default 1). A whole number, "auto" (physical cores minus one, see nm_cores()) or "ask" (interactive sessions: the cores are shown and the number is asked once per R session, then reused; options(nmpilot.n_cores = NULL) asks again). Each run is then started in the background in its own directory; if R is interrupted, the runs already started go on in the background and a later call with the same arguments picks up their results. In parallel, each run uses a working subdirectory slot<k>/ of output_dir; the estimates are appended to bootstrap_estimates.csv as the replicates end (the file is sorted by replicate when the result is assembled).

...

Former argument names, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: run_dir (now output_dir). The former name strip_table still works (R matches it to strip_tables).

Value

An object of class "nm_bootstrap" (see print()/plot()).
